integrity_notes: The root count and cusp are proved analytically from the source scalar equation. Finite checks are corroborative only. A 2013 order-two BEG paper was available only at abstract level and is retained as a residual originality risk for special physical slices.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to the symmetric translation-invariant branch \(z=t\) of the source boundary-law system. It does not classify nonsymmetric or periodic states, extremality, stability, free energies, or thermodynamic dominance.
title: Exact fold diagram for the symmetric BEG boundary-law equation on Cayley trees
